items:
A work permit must be issued, the 
 maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Close manual valve 
 for indicator line

Review technical reference material and 
 manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of indicator setting values record it in its MPRDS.
Remove temperature indicator and take it to lab
Take reading of 0% & 25% & 50% & 75% & 100%and record in data sheet

Put the temperature indicator into the oven and record the value MRDS check if 
 the reading is correct

If there is any error, adjust the temperature 
 indicator and repeat step 1 until reach the correct reading
Return the temperature back to its location
Open manual valve for temperature indicator line
Pace a copy of test result in the field maintenance file

Introduction
This 
 document outlines 
 the checklist I1 for 
 all types of pressure switches, which must be 
 performed every year as 
 indicated 
 by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Moustafa revised by eng Ashraf 
 farid Ali, accepted by eng. Adel Abdelkader Elnagar approved by eng. 
 Elsherbiny Ismail Ismail I&C maintenance general manager and approved by eng 
 Ibrahim Hassan head sector of new Talkha power station (750 M.W)
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdelgilil MDEPC quality control general 
 manager and MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb instruction 
 quality control's head sector
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the 
 maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes.
Close manual valve 
 for indicator line
Tools and Equipments
Oven temperature tester (druck DBC 150/650 
 series)
Screw driver
Set of key
Work to be carried out
Steps to prepare 
for test
Review technical reference material and 
 manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of indicator setting values record it in its MPRDS.
Remove temperature indicator and take it to lab
Take reading of 0% & 25% & 50% & 75% & 100%and record in data sheet
Calibrating 
procedure
Put the temperature indicator into the oven and record the value MRDS check if 
 the reading is correct
If there is any error, adjust the temperature 
 indicator and repeat step 1 until reach the correct reading
Return indicator to Service
Remove temperature indicator from oven
Return the temperature back to its location
Open manual valve for temperature indicator line
Pace a copy of test result in the field maintenance file
